Here we formalize this mismatch as an\\n                  <jats:italic>equilibrium-to-functionality gap</jats:italic>\\n                  and use tubulin as a stringent open-system test case.\\n                </jats:p>\\n                <jats:p>\\n                  We combine secular Lindblad, Redfield, and hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) treatments to quantify decoherence, non-perturbative relaxation, and the physical amplification required for functional relevance. Equilibrium dephasing yields a conservative\\n                  <jats:inline-formula>\\n                    <jats:inline-graphic xmlns:xlink=\\\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink\\\" xlink:href=\\\"724047v1_inline1.gif\\\"/>\\n                  </jats:inline-formula>\\n                  fs at 310 K, with a generic protein-bath baseline of ≈ 13 fs. A completed 30 ps HEOM trajectory for the full 1JFF tryptophan network shows distributed non-Markovian relaxation, with terminal purity Pur = 0.210 and stretched-exponential exponent\\n                  <jats:italic>β</jats:italic>\\n                  <jats:sub>KWW</jats:sub>\\n                  ≈ 0.44, confirming that Redfield is useful as a short-time perturbative comparator but not quantitatively interchangeable with HEOM in this intermediate-coupling regime.\\n                </jats:p>\\n                <jats:p>\\n                  We introduce a coherence-utility criterion 𝒰 = 𝒦\\n                  <jats:italic>τ</jats:italic>\\n                  <jats:sub>coh</jats:sub>\\n                  <jats:italic>/τ</jats:italic>\\n                  <jats:sub>func</jats:sub>\\n                  , separating required amplification from empirically bounded gain. A thermodynamic uncertainty relation closure shows that neural-scale cascade amplification would require\\n                  <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>\\n                  <jats:sub>min</jats:sub>\\n                  ∼ 10\\n                  <jats:sup>−7</jats:sup>\\n                  W, about five orders of magnitude above the local microtubule GTP budget. Fröhlich pumping is found to be linewidth-gated rather than generically micron-scale; ordered-water cavity QED and geometric subradiance remain experimentally testable but severely constrained candidates.\\n                </jats:p>\\n                <jats:p>The result is not a model of consciousness, but a reproducible physical benchmark framework for evaluating biological quantum-coherence claims under explicit open-system, energetic, and experimental constraints. Six falsifiable experimental programmes are prioritized, and the full computational framework is released with a validation ledger, cryptographic audit trail, and living supplementary material.</jats:p>\\n                <jats:sec>\\n                  <jats:title>Abstract Figure</jats:title>\\n                  <jats:fig id=\\\"ufig1\\\" position=\\\"float\\\" fig-type=\\\"figure\\\" orientation=\\\"portrait\\\">\\n                    <jats:label>Graphical abstract.</jats:label>\\n                    <jats:caption>\\n                      <jats:p>Equilibrium tubulin coherence lies in the femtosecond regime, while functional neural timescales lie in the millisecond regime. Fröhlich pumping, QED-cavity protection, and geometric subradiance remain experimentally discriminable non-equilibrium candidates requiring independently bounded amplification.</jats:p>\\n                    </jats:caption>\\n                    <jats:graphic xmlns:xlink=\\\"http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink\\\" xlink:href=\\\"724047v1_ufig1\\\" position=\\\"float\\\" orientation=\\\"portrait\\\"/>\\n                  </jats:fig>\\n                </jats:sec>\\n                <jats:sec>\\n                  <jats:title>Funding</jats:title>\\n                  <jats:p>This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.</jats:p>\\n                </jats:sec>\\n                <jats:sec>\\n                  <jats:title>Versioned computational scope of this release</jats:title>\\n                  <jats:p>\\n                    This manuscript reports the theoretical framework, calibrated equilibrium baseline, Redfield/HEOM validation ledger, stratified Bayesian evidence synthesis, classical comparators, and falsifiable experimental design. The release-specific reproduction audit, including the current validation-check total and the SHA-256 fingerprints of the binary production artefacts (\\n                    <jats:monospace>.npz</jats:monospace>\\n                    ,\\n                    <jats:monospace>.pkl</jats:monospace>\\n                    ), is documented in\\n                    <jats:monospace>LIVING_SI.md</jats:monospace>\\n                    and\\n                    <jats:monospace>outputs_data/raw_json/structur al/validation_report.json</jats:monospace>\\n                    . A completed 30 ps HEOM production trajectory has been validated on constrained hardware; the master dataset contains the full 8-site population trajectory. A summary of those results is provided in §\\n                    <jats:underline>2.2.5</jats:underline>\\n                    . All claims made below are restricted to the numerical and theoretical evidence reported in this manuscript and its associated repository artefacts. The public repository ships the calibrated phenomenological baseline for accessibility; the HEOM production artefacts serve as the non-perturbative validation benchmark. All source figure outputs associated with this release are maintained in the public repository under\\n                    <jats:monospace>outputs_data/figures_final/</jats:monospace>\\n                    .\\n                  </jats:p>\\n                </jats:sec>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.10.724047\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026, 5, 13]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "8a05e59b2931f64f9574023044e2d1b9a5fabc3bcf99cea1effe860a9e13bd00", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "heredity_thresholds", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1021/acs.chemmater.3c02228.s001", "doi:10.1016/0304-3975(86)90156-8", "doi:10.1016/j.tcs.2009.05.012", "doi:10.64898/2026.05.10.724047"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.chemmater.3c02228.s001", "https://doi.org/10.1016/0304-3975(86)90156-8", "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tcs.2009.05.012", "https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.10.724047"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}

review.alternative: Heritable information might be maintained through passive structural constraints without active information erasure.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence of persistent, stable chemical memory that operates below the Landauer limit without environmental heat-bath coupling.

claims.statement: Thermodynamic erasure costs impose fundamental lower bounds on the energy required to maintain heritable information in prebiotic systems.

support.explanation: Information retention requires non-zero energy expenditure; thus, persistent heritable memory is physically constrained by the cost of erasing state-defining bits.
support.passage: The energy cost of erasing a bit of information was fundamentally lower bounded by Landauer

review.alternative: Evolutionary transitions may occur entirely within shielded compartments where objectivity is not required for selection.
review.would_change_mind: Observation of evolutionary dynamics in systems where no identifiable pointer states can be distinguished by external environmental interactions.

claims.statement: The transition from a mixture of non-heritable species to an evolutionary network requires objective pointer states to emerge from environmental interactions.

support.explanation: Objectivity emerges when environmental degrees of freedom act as a broadcast structure for preferred states, a necessary condition for independent observers to verify evolutionary progress.
support.passage: how to explain on quantum grounds the objective character of the macroscopic world

support.explanation: This identifies the fundamental problem: overcoming the noise of a mixed state to achieve consistent, selectable organization.
support.passage: A major challenge is to understand the transition from a mixture of m

actions.findings:
Thermodynamic erasure costs impose fundamental lower bounds on the energy required to maintain heritable information in prebiotic systems. [peer-3d80ce4af7c184d54bcc9333]

The transition from a mixture of non-heritable species to an evolutionary network requires objective pointer states to emerge from environmental interactions. [peer-d062550a82ade2a0aa128e16] [source-ef3adfea90114662]
actions.limitations: Findings assume idealized Markovian environmental couplings; the transition from theoretical thermodynamic lower bounds to empirically observable compositional fidelity in complex, noisy environments remains under-determined.
actions.next_questions: Determine whether the erasure cost threshold uniquely predicts the onset of Darwinian evolution in non-templated autocatalytic networks.
actions.reason: Revision required to incorporate thermodynamic constraints on information retention and the criteria for objective state persistence.
actions.summary: Integration of thermodynamic erasure costs into the heredity threshold framework demonstrates that the transition from simple chemical mixtures to evolutionary systems is constrained by both information-theoretic erasure limits and the requirement for objective pointer states.
actions.title: Heredity Thresholds and Stoichiometric Conditions in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
